title: Publication
description: PROPOSED by ICDEV[IT] (icx-cop-01) for ICDEV[OS] to pin; not yet in its contract. The publication of one icos-cop-academy/v1 batch: a person who did not prepare it took the declared step decl-wft-cop-academy-xapi-publish, bound to the batch's content_digest. It travels BESIDE the batch (the batch schema forbids extra fields), so ICDEV[OS] can refuse a batch nobody published, or one published by its preparer, before it imports it.

content_digest.description: the content_digest of the batch it publishes; it must equal the batch's

signed_by.description: the person who took the publish step (an ICDEV[IT] account id, never the preparer)

role.description: that person's role when they took it

prepared_by.description: who prepared the batch (a person's account id, or agent:<name>)

step_id.description: the declared step in ICDEV[IT]'s wf_decision_steps

event_id.description: the published event in ICDEV[IT]'s cop_academy_events

row_hash.description: that event's hash on ICDEV[IT]'s hash chain
